get.summary: Liveness check — confirms the API process is up and responding.

403.description: Credentials are valid but the account has not been approved by an admin yet (or was rejected). The response message is written to be shown to the user as-is.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password, returning a bearer token for use everywhere else.

400.description: Validation failed — most commonly a non-NRS email address (only @nrs.gov.ng is accepted) or a password under 8 characters.

409.description: An account or a pending request already exists for this email address.

post.summary: Request a Pulse account with an NRS work email. Creates the account in a pending state and notifies every admin — no session is returned, and the person cannot sign in until an admin approves them in the Users section.

403.description: The account exists but is still pending approval, or was rejected.

404.description: No Pulse account exists for this email address.

503.description: Supabase could not send the email (e.g. SMTP is not configured on the project). The admin can issue a reset link manually from the Users section instead.

post.summary: Email a password reset link. Only works for an email that already has an approved Pulse account — an unknown address gets a 404 rather than a silent success, so nobody waits on an email that was never going to arrive.

204.description: Password updated — the user can now sign in.

400.description: The new password is shorter than 8 characters.

401.description: The reset link is invalid or has expired.

403.description: The account is still pending approval, or was rejected.

post.summary: Set a new password using the recovery token from a reset link (emailed, or issued by an admin).

403.description: The account was rejected or un-approved after this token was issued.

get.summary: Return the caller's own profile — id, role, and workstream scope.

parameters.name: include_archived
parameters.description: Include archived (soft-deleted) workstreams in the results.

get.summary: List all workstreams, in TWG display order. Archived workstreams are excluded unless include_archived=true.

403.description: Caller is not admin or smo.

get.summary: Per-workstream initiative counts by RAG status — replaces the old Excel Summary sheet.
Get a single workstream by id.

403.description: Caller is not admin or smo.

patch.summary: Admin/SMO-only: rename a workstream or change its display order.

403.description: Caller is not admin or smo.

delete.summary: Admin/SMO-only: archive (soft-delete) a workstream. Refuses if it still has active initiatives. The row is never hard-deleted — see POST /workstreams/:id/restore.

403.description: Caller is not admin or smo.

post.summary: Admin/SMO-only: restore a previously archived workstream.

parameters.name: workstream_id
parameters.description: Filter to initiatives in a single workstream.

parameters.name: include_archived
parameters.description: Include archived (soft-deleted) initiatives in the results.

get.summary: List initiatives (current-state snapshot), optionally filtered by workstream and/or status. Archived initiatives are excluded unless include_archived=true.

403.description: Caller is not admin or smo.

post.summary: Admin/SMO-only: register a new initiative against a workstream. Status defaults to "Not started" if omitted.

get.summary: Get a single initiative by id.

403.description: Caller is not admin or smo.

patch.summary: Admin/SMO-only direct correction to an initiative snapshot. Bypasses the normal fortnightly initiative_updates flow — use to fix mistakes, not for routine reporting.

403.description: Caller is not admin or smo.

delete.summary: Admin/SMO-only: archive (soft-delete) an initiative. Its milestones and update history are kept intact — see POST /initiatives/:id/restore.

403.description: Caller is not admin or smo.

post.summary: Admin/SMO-only: restore a previously archived initiative.

get.summary: List milestones for one initiative, in display order.

403.description: Caller is not admin or smo.

post.summary: Admin/SMO-only: add a new milestone under an initiative. Appends to the end unless a sequence is given.

403.description: Caller is not admin or smo.

404.description: No milestone with that id under this initiative.

403.description: Caller is not admin or smo.

404.description: No milestone with that id under this initiative.

delete.summary: Admin/SMO-only: permanently delete a milestone. Unlike initiatives/workstreams this is a hard delete — a milestone carries no history of its own.

get.summary: List the fortnightly update history for an initiative, newest first. The full audit trail is readable by everyone authenticated.

403.description: Caller is a workstream_lead submitting for an initiative outside their workstream.

post.summary: Submit a fortnightly update for an initiative. This is the append-only path leads use instead of editing the initiative directly — a trigger promotes the newest submission onto the initiative snapshot.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only return accounts in this approval state. Omit for all accounts.

403.description: Caller is not an admin.

get.summary: List every Pulse account with its approval state, role and workstream — newest request first. Filter with ?status=pending to see just the accounts waiting for approval.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Profile id (uuid) of the account to approve.

400.description: role is workstream_lead but no workstreamId was given.

403.description: Caller is not an admin.

404.description: No account (or no workstream) with that id.

409.description: The account is already approved, or the workstream is archived.

post.summary: Approve a pending account, setting the role (and the workstream, for a lead) it should have. The person can sign in as soon as this succeeds.

403.description: Caller is not an admin.

409.description: You cannot reject your own account, or the only remaining approved admin.

post.summary: Decline an account request (or revoke an approved account). The account stays in the list, cannot sign in, and any live session it holds stops working on its next request.

400.description: Nothing to update, or a lead was left without a workstream.

403.description: Caller is not an admin.

404.description: No account (or no workstream) with that id.

409.description: You cannot remove your own admin role, or demote the only remaining approved admin.

patch.summary: Change an existing account’s name, role, or workstream. Role and workstream are kept consistent automatically: a lead must have a workstream, admin/smo must have none.

403.description: Caller is not an admin.

409.description: You cannot delete your own account, or the only remaining approved admin.

delete.summary: Permanently delete an account. Submitted TWG updates are preserved — the append-only initiative_updates history keeps its rows and simply loses the link to this author.

403.description: Caller is not an admin.

409.description: The account is not approved yet.

503.description: Supabase could not generate a recovery link.

post.summary: Generate a one-time password reset link for an approved account and return it, without emailing anything. Use this when the project has no SMTP configured, or when someone cannot receive the automated email — the admin passes the link on directly.

parameters.name: unread_only
parameters.description: Return only notifications the caller has not read yet.

get.summary: The caller's own notifications, newest first (max 50). Today the only kind is an account-request alert sent to admins when somebody signs up and needs approval.

404.description: No such notification for this caller.

post.summary: Mark one of the caller’s own notifications as read.
Mark every unread notification for the caller as read.

id.description: Profile id — matches the Supabase auth user id.

role.description: admin/smo can read and write everything. workstream_lead is scoped to workstreamId.

workstreamId.description: The workstream this user is scoped to. Always null for admin/smo.

refreshToken.description: Supabase refresh token, for obtaining a new access token.

expiresAt.description: Unix epoch seconds at which accessToken expires.

fullName.description: The person’s full name, as it should appear in Pulse.

email.description: NRS work email. Use your NRS work email (e.g. john.lewis@nrs.gov.ng). Other email domains cannot be used to create a Pulse account.

status.description: Always 'pending' from this endpoint. No session is issued — the account cannot sign in until an admin approves it in the Users section.

message.description: Message to show the user — tells them approval is pending and to contact the admin if it takes too long.

email.description: The NRS email of an existing, approved Pulse account. Use your NRS work email (e.g. john.lewis@nrs.gov.ng). Other email domains cannot be used to create a Pulse account.

message.description: Human-readable confirmation, safe to show the user as-is.
message.example: A password reset link has been sent to john.lewis@nrs.gov.ng.

token.description: The recovery token from the emailed reset link (the `access_token` in the link’s URL fragment), or the token from an admin-issued reset link.

password.description: The new password, at least 8 characters.

name.description: The TWG's name for this organizational grouping.

sort_order.description: Display order in TWG materials — ascending.

created_at.description: ISO timestamp the workstream row was created.

archived_at.description: ISO timestamp this workstream was archived (soft-deleted). Null = active.

name.description: The TWG's name for this organizational grouping.

sort_order.description: Display order in TWG materials — ascending. Defaults to last if omitted.
Display order in TWG materials — ascending.

workstream_id.description: Id of the workstream this initiative belongs to.

title.description: Initiative title as shown in TWG materials.

directorate_owner.description: Directorate that owns this initiative. Empty on every row currently — a known data gap inherited from the prior SharePoint register, not a Pulse defect. Do not backfill with guesses.

decisions_needed.description: Decisions needed from the TWG, if any.

update_as_at.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) this snapshot reflects — set by the latest applied update.

created_at.description: ISO timestamp the initiative row was created.

updated_at.description: ISO timestamp of the last change to this row.

archived_at.description: ISO timestamp this initiative was archived (soft-deleted). Null = active.

workstream_id.description: Id of the workstream this initiative belongs to.

title.description: Initiative title as shown in TWG materials.

directorate_owner.description: Directorate that owns this milestone. Empty on every row currently — same known data gap as initiatives.directorate_owner. Do not backfill with guesses.

target_date.description: Approximate target date (YYYY-MM-DD) — parsed from month-level TWG deck labels (e.g. "Aug-26" → first of month) except where the deck gave an exact day. Do not present as a precise due date without this caveat.

sequence.description: Display order within the parent initiative.

created_at.description: ISO timestamp the milestone row was created.

updated_at.description: ISO timestamp of the last change to this row.

target_date.description: Target date (YYYY-MM-DD). Treat as approximate — see MilestoneDto.

sequence.description: Display order within the parent initiative. Defaults to last if omitted.

target_date.description: Target date (YYYY-MM-DD). Treat as approximate — see MilestoneDto.

sequence.description: Display order within the parent initiative.

initiative_id.description: Initiative this update was submitted for.

submitted_by.description: Profile id of whoever submitted this.

meeting_date.description: The TWG meeting date (YYYY-MM-DD) this update is for.

created_at.description: ISO timestamp this update was submitted.

meeting_date.description: The TWG meeting date (YYYY-MM-DD) this update is for.

status.description: Current RAG status as of this update.

target.description: Updated target narrative, if it has changed.

actual.description: Updated actual-progress narrative, if it has changed.

latest_update.description: The fortnightly progress narrative for this initiative.

decisions_needed.description: Any decision the TWG needs to make on this initiative.

id.description: Profile id — matches the Supabase auth user id.

role.description: admin can read/write everything and manage users. smo can read/write everything. workstream_lead is scoped to workstreamId.

workstreamId.description: The workstream this user is scoped to. Null for admin/smo.

workstreamName.description: Name of that workstream, resolved for display. Null when workstreamId is null.

status.description: 'pending' accounts exist but cannot sign in. Only an admin can move an account to 'approved'.

approvedAt.description: ISO timestamp this account was approved or rejected.

approvedBy.description: Profile id of the admin who approved/rejected this account. Null for profiles created before self-service sign-up existed.

rejectionReason.description: Note the admin left when rejecting the request. Admin-facing only.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp the account was requested/created.

role.description: The role to grant on approval. Sign-up never lets someone choose their own role — this is the admin’s decision.

workstreamId.description: Workstream to scope this user to. Required when role is workstream_lead; must be omitted (or null) for admin/smo, which are not workstream-scoped.

reason.description: Optional note on why the request was declined. Stored for the admin’s own reference — it is not shown to the applicant.

workstreamId.description: Change the workstream a lead is scoped to. Pass null to clear it (required when moving someone to admin/smo).

resetLink.description: One-time password-recovery link to hand to the user directly. Use this when Supabase email delivery is not configured — it is generated, not emailed.

recipient_id.description: Profile id this notification belongs to — always the caller.

type.description: Machine-readable kind. Currently only 'account_request' (someone signed up and is waiting for admin approval).

title.description: Short headline, safe to render as-is.

body.description: Longer detail line, e.g. who requested access and from which email.

link.description: In-app path the notification links to, e.g. '/users'.

subject_email.description: The email address this notification is about, where applicable. Kept even if that account is later deleted.

read_at.description: ISO timestamp the recipient read this. Null = unread.

created_at.description: ISO timestamp the notification was created.
